name: marketplace-reporting
description: The Amazon Web Services Marketplace GetBuyerDashboard API enables you to get a procurement insights dashboard programmatically.

subcommands.name: get-buyer-dashboard
subcommands.description: Generates an embedding URL for an Amazon QuickSight dashboard for an anonymous user.

options.name: --dashboard-identifier
options.description: The ARN of the requested dashboard

options.name: --embedding-domains
options.description: Fully qualified domains that you add to the allow list for access to the generated URL that is then embedded.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided. The JSON string follows the format provided by ``--generate-cli-skeleton``.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
